recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future alternate-code changes should be handled under later dedicated tickets such as FHIR-44627 or in the FHIR Extension Pack if the moved extension definition itself needs maintenance.
issue_request: FHIR-14013 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary request to add CodeSystem capability for multiple codes per concept; the final resolution selected an alternate extension instead of changing CodeSystem.concept.code cardinality.
initial_application: The Jira comment's svn revision 12746 corresponds to git commit bda4a109ec8e5d17fcd0a356ca2befa7282815a0, which added CodeSystem alternate-code extension spreadsheet content and the alternate-code-kind value set. Later R5 source cleanup removed core extension definitions, including codesystem-alternate, as part of moving extensions out of core.
additional_context: The current FHIR Extension Pack contains the old codesystem-alternate extension for CodeSystem.concept. Later core work, especially FHIR-44627, adopted the R6 approach of duplicate CodeSystem.concept entries related by alternateCode, with codeKind for code characteristics and a reciprocal alternateCode invariant; FHIR-39542 is background that rejected an earlier synonym rename and pointed to a new solution.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the current active CodeSystem source and active concept-properties CodeSystem already convey the multiple-code capability through the later property model. Editing or reintroducing the old core extension definition would be out of build scope and inconsistent with later WG decisions.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision that documents the current alternateCode/codeKind property approach and reciprocal constraint for CodeSystem alternate codes.
